assessment.reason: Recent usage supports a near-even chance of 2+ catches, and +175 is the best of six quotes at the same line. No material blocker is identified. The gap to the market is large, and the model is unvalidated.
assessment.model_case: He had 2+ catches in four of eight sampled games, including three of the last four, with 4 targets in each of the last two. The 1.55 projection sits just over 1.5. Defense and venue adjustments nearly cancel, so the case rests on about 3 recency-weighted targets at a coin-flip catch rate. Five games with two or fewer targets is the main weakness.
assessment.price_case: The main line of 1.5 at +175 needs about a 4-in-11 hit rate. It beats BetMGM +155 through DraftKings +167, and all five other books sit at 1.5 with de-vigged prices near break-even. Value requires the recent target level to hold. Being the best price is not independent confirmation.
assessment.context_case: Only Buffalo's report is supplied. Benford's questionable status could modestly ease coverage. Allen's own status and Chiefs receiver availability are unverified. Absences in weeks 2, 3 and 5 are unexplained.

qualitative_review.countercase: Five books between +155 and +167 imply roughly one-in-three odds. They may be pricing a fringe role in which targets revert to 1-2. Recency weighting leans on two 4-target games. A normal curve applied to a tiny count may overstate the over. Returning Chiefs receivers or a run-heavy script could cut his snaps.
